Mastery gates

How this teaches the chart

The real connecting lines remain in view. You retrieve each label from spatial context—not from a blank sheet—and then graduate to no-word-bank recall. Each round has immediate correction.

Exact-source note

This is the BL 7.2B (U) Aegis Destroyer Combat System chart you supplied. Red, yellow, and blue refer to the chart’s own legend. The exercise masks the original labels, while keeping the wiring and original diagram visible; it does not invent a new network diagram.

Explain without the notes

Commander's oral board

Conceptual short-answer challenges. Explain each aloud or type it, reveal a grading rubric, then rate your answer. You should be able to defend the “because.”

Evidence and scope

Know what is on the exam

Course scope: Exam 3 lecture slides 1–39 only, instructor speaker notes, Joint Staff JFRP handout, and the exact BL 7.2B chart. Official public references are included for context—not silently substituted for the course's annotated claims.

Course source priority

Primary: instructor's Exam 3(1).pptx and its speaker notes (through slide 39). Secondary: RRQM 001 Joint Staff/WAU JFRP briefing (January 2026). AEGIS chart: user-uploaded BL 7.2B exact original. Where course notes describe later August 2026 rules, these are labeled as the instructor's update rather than incorrectly attributed to the January webinar.

Outside official references

Official pages may need internet access when opened; the learning course itself does not.
